## What changed?

Describe the change clearly and briefly.

## Why does it improve the framework?

Explain the product or evaluation problem this change solves.

## Framework impact

Check all that apply:

- [ ] Scoring behavior changes
- [ ] Canonical terminology changes
- [ ] `SKILL.md` behavior changes
- [ ] JSON/schema changes
- [ ] Arabic wording changes
- [ ] English wording changes
- [ ] Examples only / no framework behavior change

## Consistency checklist

- [ ] I used the canonical terms in `TERMINOLOGY.md`.
- [ ] I did not award current score for a hypothetical future moat.
- [ ] I avoided double-counting the same advantage across dimensions.
- [ ] I updated all affected prompts, docs, examples, and schema fields together.
- [ ] I verified the JSON example against the schema when applicable.

## Evidence

If this change relies on a real company, product, benchmark, or factual claim, link the supporting sources and separate evidence from interpretation.

## Maintainer approval

Changes are merged into `main` only after review and approval by the repository maintainer.
